description: Frontend: UI to upload a new docker-compose deployment plan (compose file + name, plus required instanceType and optional model/description), and to list and delete user-uploaded plans. Adds a new nav tab + page, and the API client methods. The BookingPage dropdown already loads plans dynamically from GET /status, so newly uploaded plans appear for booking automatically. Depends on FEAT-001/FEAT-002 for the API contract (POST/GET/DELETE /deployment-plans and the merged /status deploymentPlans including source).
steps: In platform/frontend/src/types.ts: extend DeploymentPlan with optional fields `source?: 'builtin' | 'user'`, `modelName?: string`, `composeFile?: string`. Add a request type CreateDeploymentPlanRequest { name: string; instanceType: string; composeContent: string; modelName?: string; description?: string; recipe?: string; overwrite?: boolean }.

In platform/frontend/src/api/client.ts: add createDeploymentPlan(req: CreateDeploymentPlanRequest) => POST /deployment-plans; listDeploymentPlans() => GET /deployment-plans returning { plans: DeploymentPlan[] } (return resp.plans); deleteDeploymentPlan(planId: string) => DELETE /deployment-plans/{planId}. Follow the existing request<T>() helper pattern and Basic-auth handling.

Create platform/frontend/src/pages/PlansPage.tsx: an antd page with (a) an upload form: Input for name, Select for instanceType with options for the supported GPU types (p5en.48xlarge, p6-b300.48xlarge) matching the backend allowlist, optional Input for modelName (placeholder deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and description, and an antd Upload (beforeUpload to read the .yaml/.yml file text via FileReader, prevent auto-upload, store content in state). On submit call createDeploymentPlan with composeContent = file text; show success/error via message; refresh the list. (b) a Table listing plans from listDeploymentPlans() with columns name, id, instanceType, source, and a Delete action (Popconfirm) that is disabled/hidden for source==='builtin' and calls deleteDeploymentPlan for user plans. Mirror the styling conventions used in HistoryPage.tsx / SettingsPage.tsx (Card, Table, antd message).

In platform/frontend/src/App.tsx: add a nav item to NAV_ITEMS (e.g. { key: '/plans', label: '方案管理', icon: <CloudUploadOutlined /> }) importing CloudUploadOutlined from @ant-design/icons; add '/plans' to BREADCRUMB_MAP with label '方案管理'; add <Route path="/plans" element={<PlansPage />} /> and import PlansPage. Place the tab logically (e.g. right after 创建预约).
Optionally in platform/frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: annotate user plans in the Select label (e.g. append ' (自定义)' when plan.source === 'user'). Nice-to-have, keep minimal.

If node/npm are available, run: cd platform/frontend && npm install && npm run build (tsc typecheck + vite build) and fix any type errors. If node/npm are not available in the sandbox, record that build validation is deferred and instead do a careful TypeScript review to ensure imports, types, and the new page compile (no undeclared identifiers, correct antd component props, DeploymentPlan.source used consistently).
acceptance_criteria: A new '方案管理' tab/route exists and renders PlansPage.
PlansPage lets the user pick a local .yaml/.yml file and enter a name + instanceType, then POSTs composeContent + metadata to /deployment-plans and shows success.
PlansPage lists merged plans and allows deleting user (source==='user') plans but not built-ins.
api/client.ts has createDeploymentPlan/listDeploymentPlans/deleteDeploymentPlan following the existing request<T>() + Basic-auth pattern.
types.ts DeploymentPlan carries optional source and the CreateDeploymentPlanRequest type exists.
If node available: npm run build (tsc) passes with no type errors.
verification: If node/npm available: cd platform/frontend && npm install && npm run build must succeed (runs tsc then vite build).

If node/npm unavailable: TypeScript source review confirming new page, client methods, types, and App.tsx wiring are internally consistent and use existing patterns; note build deferred to orchestrator due to sandbox lacking node.
